title: Reserve an in-stock product for pickup
description: This verifies that a shopper can create a pickup reservation from a product card and complete the reservation form successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open an in-stock product's reservation form
Fill in the reservation details with valid information
Submit the reservation form
Verify a reservation confirmation is visible
Verify the reservation appears as created

title: Reserve a product for store pickup
description: This verifies that a customer can submit a pickup reservation from a product card and receive a completion confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open the reservation form for an in-stock product
Fill in the customer name field with a valid name
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the quantity field with a valid quantity
Fill in the pickup date field with a valid date
Fill in the notes field with reservation notes
Submit the reservation form
Verify a reservation success confirmation is visible

title: Open the products catalog from the homepage
description: This verifies that a visitor can use the homepage navigation to reach the product catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the products link in the navigation
Verify the products catalog is displayed

title: Browse products from the homepage
description: This verifies that a shopper can move from the homepage into the product catalog and start browsing items.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view products
Verify the product catalog is displayed

title: Sign in with phone passcode and reach the customer area
description: This verifies that a registered customer can sign in with a phone number and passcode and land in the customer account area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the phone sign-in mode
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the passcode field with a 6-digit passcode
Submit the login form
Verify the customer dashboard is displayed

title: Open the login page from the homepage
description: This verifies that a visitor can use the homepage navigation to reach the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the login link in the navigation
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Search and filter the product catalog
description: This verifies that a shopper can narrow the catalog by searching and category filtering to find relevant materials.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Fill in the product search field with a valid material name
Select a category filter
Verify matching products are displayed
Verify the catalog is narrowed to the selected category

title: Access the admin dashboard from login
description: This verifies that an admin user can sign in and reach the dashboard used to review reservations and stock metrics.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Open the admin access mode
Fill in the admin email field with a valid admin email
Fill in the admin password field with a valid admin password
Submit the admin access form
Verify the admin dashboard is displayed

title: Compare two products
description: This verifies that a shopper can select two products and open the comparison view before choosing one to reserve.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Select the first product for comparison
Select the second product for comparison
Open the comparison view
Verify two products are shown in the comparison view

title: Sign in with email and reach the customer area
description: This verifies that a registered customer can sign in with email and 6-digit passcode and land in their account area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the email sign-in mode
Fill in the email field with a valid customer email
Fill in the passcode field with a valid 6-digit passcode
Submit the login form
Verify the customer account area is displayed
Verify the user is signed in

title: Review reservation analytics and pickup lists in the admin dashboard
description: This verifies that an admin can open the dashboard and review the reservation summary, pickup list, and stock metrics needed for operations.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Open the admin access mode
Fill in the admin email field with a valid admin email
Fill in the admin password field with a valid admin password
Submit the admin access form
Verify reservation analytics are displayed
Verify pickup list and stock metrics are displayed

title: Filter products by category
description: This verifies that a customer can switch product categories and see the catalog update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Select a product category tab
Verify the products for the selected category are displayed

title: Register a new customer account
description: This verifies that a new customer can complete registration and see a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the registration mode
Fill in the name field with a new customer name
Fill in the email field with a new customer email
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the passcode field with a 6-digit passcode
Submit the registration form
Verify a registration success confirmation is visible

title: Show reservation required-field validation
description: This verifies that the reservation form prevents submission until required details are provided.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Open the reservation form for an in-stock product
Submit the reservation form
Verify reservation validation errors are visible

title: Reset the catalog after searching or filtering
description: This verifies that a customer can clear a search or switch back to the full catalog after narrowing results.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Type a search query into the product search field
Clear the search field
Verify the full product catalog is displayed

title: Open the contact page from the homepage
description: This verifies that a visitor can use the homepage navigation to reach the contact page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the contact link in the navigation
Verify the contact page is displayed

title: Use Nova to ask a materials question
description: This verifies that a shopper can ask Nova a materials question and receive an answer in the chat interface.

steps.description: Navigate to /nova
Type a materials question into the chat input
Send the message
Verify the assistant response is displayed

title: Ask a materials question and review the answer
description: This verifies that a customer can ask Nova a construction question and see a helpful response in the chat.

steps.description: Navigate to /nova
Type a construction materials question into the chat input
Send the message
Verify Nova's response is displayed
Verify the conversation shows the user's message and Nova's reply

title: Open the Nova assistant from the homepage
description: This verifies that a visitor can use the homepage navigation to reach the Nova assistant.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Nova assistant link in the navigation
Verify the Nova assistant page is displayed

title: Open the contact page and view business details
description: This verifies that a visitor can navigate to the contact page and see the business address, hours, map, and contact information.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Verify the business address is displayed
Verify the business hours, map, and contact details are displayed

title: Continue a Nova conversation with a follow-up message
description: This verifies that a customer can keep chatting with Nova after an initial response and see both turns in the thread.

steps.description: Navigate to /nova
Type a construction materials question into the chat input
Send the message
Type a follow-up question into the chat input
Send the message
Verify the chat shows multiple exchanged messages
Verify the latest Nova response is displayed

title: Use Telugu voice dictation to send a question
description: This verifies that a customer can dictate a question in Telugu and submit the transcribed message in Nova chat.

steps.description: Navigate to /nova
Activate voice dictation
Speak a question in Telugu
Verify the dictated text appears in the chat input
Send the message
Verify Nova's response is displayed

title: Upload a crack image for analysis
description: This verifies that a customer can upload a structural crack image in Nova and see analysis guidance in the chat.

steps.description: Navigate to /nova
Upload a structural crack image
Verify the uploaded image is shown in the conversation
Verify Nova's analysis or suggestion is displayed

title: Hear Nova's response playback
description: This verifies that a customer can trigger audio playback after receiving a Nova response.

steps.description: Navigate to /nova
Type a construction materials question into the chat input
Send the message
Start playback of Nova's response audio
Verify audio playback is active
Verify the chat response remains visible while audio is playing

title: Reject an invalid phone passcode
description: This verifies that a customer sees a validation error when entering an invalid phone passcode and cannot proceed to the account area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the phone sign-in mode
Fill in the phone number field with a valid phone number
Fill in the passcode field with an invalid passcode
Submit the login form
Verify a passcode validation error is visible
Verify the customer dashboard is not displayed

title: Require all registration fields before creating an account
description: This verifies that registration blocks submission until all required customer details are provided.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the registration mode
Fill in only the name field with a new customer name
Submit the registration form
Verify registration validation errors are displayed
Verify no success confirmation is visible

title: Show sign-in validation for invalid email or passcode
description: This verifies that email sign-in shows validation feedback when the credentials are not acceptable.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the email sign-in mode
Fill in the email field with an invalid email value
Fill in the passcode field with an invalid 6-digit value
Submit the login form
Verify sign-in validation errors are displayed
Verify the customer account area is not displayed

title: Show a validation state for empty chat submission
description: This verifies that Nova prevents sending an empty message and shows a validation state.

steps.description: Navigate to /nova
Send an empty message
Verify a validation message is displayed
Verify no new chat message is added
